name: MCP4725
description: Microchip MCP4725 12-bit DAC (I²C). The part is command-oriented (fast-write has no register pointer); these rows are inspector shadows so Registers can poke the live code. Matches Zephyr drivers/dac/dac_mcp4725.c.

registers.name: DAC_CODE
registers.description: Shadow of the last DAC output code (12-bit). Poke updates Vout like a fast-write.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Shadow of the first status byte returned on I²C read (RDY in bit 7).

registers.name: EEPROM_CODE
registers.description: Last code written to NV EEPROM (if any); 0 when unused.
